narrations.hook: What if the tool designed to break a law actually breaks your right to use your own 3D printer?
scenes: Cody Wilson created the first 3D-printed gun, sparking controversy.
New York has a law preventing 3D printers from making firearms.
Wilson's 'Hochulization' tool bypasses this law, named after Governor Kathy Hochul.
Hochul warned about the tool's dangers on the show Decoder.
The tool wasn't built for hobbyists, but as a legal test case, targeting ordinary citizens.
narrations.cta: Do you think Governor Hochul is right to be worried about the 'Hochulization' tool?
narrations.title: The real reason 3D-printed guns are a threat to your rights

narrations.hook: What's behind the staggering $31.6 trillion price tag of the AI revolution by 2050, a sum that's more than the entire US GDP?
scenes: Global data center spending is set to jump from $800 billion in 2026 to $1.8 trillion in 2050, with the US and Asia-Pacific region leading the charge. The US is expected to capture nearly half of this spending, with $15.1 trillion going towards data centers, while the Asia-Pacific region will invest $8.2 trillion, driven by growing demand for AI. This massive investment will be fueled by the need to upgrade AI infrastructure every 4 to 6 years, creating a constant cycle of investment.
narrations.cta: What do you think is the most significant way this data center spending boom will affect your daily life, from increased costs to potential benefits?
narrations.title: AI Boom: 31 Trillion Price Tag
